Hi Samira — thanks for the clear questions. Short answers up front: yes, subsidies can coexist with Redwood promo credits in most cases; and we offer a limited rollback mechanism but it has accounting guardrails.

Details / proposed playbook:
- Eligibility: serverless promo credits (time-limited) can be applied alongside program-issued sandbox stipends so long as the sandbox stipend owner (BluePeak) agrees to allow conversion to reserved capacity credits.
- Conversion: when a startup chooses a reserved commit, we can convert unused promo credits into reserved capacity credits on a pro rata basis. That conversion must be requested within 45 days from the start of the reserved term.
- Rollback / clawback: we support a one-time rollback for cases where a sponsor-funded subsidy overlaps a conversion (for example, sponsor provided voucher expected to be consumed pre-conversion). Rollback is limited to unused subsidy amounts and requires: sponsor attestation, an accounting reconciliation sheet, and a signed amendment.
- Timing & steps (high level): 1) Founder requests conversion -> 2) Redwood issues provisional conversion estimate -> 3) Sponsor confirms allowance for conversion -> 4) Accounting reconciliation and amendment -> 5) Final credit mapping and provisioning. Typical elapsed time: 7–14 business days.

I'm attaching a draft schedule and a short ops playbook that outlines the reconciliation fields your finance team will ask for. Ben and Laura are cc'd for any pricing/finance questions; Ben can propose a sample discount structure if you want to layer a cohort discount on top of reserved-tier pricing.

Would you like us to turn this into a mutual action plan (MAP) that lists founder steps and timelines? If so, we can draft one and send it back for BluePeak legal to review.

Best,

Samira — quick note on discounts and the cohort mechanics.

We can offer a cohort-level onboarding discount that applies when a cohort converts at least 6 teams to Reserved within the first 90 days. Proposed starter: 10% off committed spend for the first 6 months (applies to reserved-tier token pricing). That discount stacks on top of any converted promo-credit value; discounts cannot reduce converted-credit value but will reduce the remaining billable amount.

Two operational asks from Redwood's side:
- BluePeak finance signs the sponsor attestation template (we can draft).
- For bookkeeping, please provide founder-level subsidy allocations (email + expected stipend amount) in the attached schedule format so our accounting can map vouchers to accounts.

If that sounds okay I can draft a short MAP with milestones (Founders opt-in -> Sponsor sign-off -> Accounting reconciliation -> Conversion complete). Happy to take ownership on Redwood side.
